result.question: Quais os cinco municípios com mais internações obstétricas registradas?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
